description: PROP-P11-skip asserts 'iff one of 4 conditions hold; the 4 are enumerable' but the v2 REQ-P11 enumerates only 3 conditions (a, b, c). Iter-1 FIND-011 said either add a 5th condition or fold it in. v2 went the other direction (removed presenter-mode sentinel per FIND-013 fix) so the actual count is now 3, not 4. PROP-P11 was not adjusted. A unit-test that asserts exactly-4 enumerable conditions will fail or be tuned around the spec. The number must be aligned (PROP says 3 and matches REQ).
